wiringInterpretation.rationale: Plan_final 09-006 wires the projectile weapons via one src/vanilla facade (wireProjectileWeapons.ts) re-exporting the read-only src/player/projectiles.ts (aFireMissile rocket, aFirePlasma, aFireBFG, aBFGSpray + spawnPlayerMissile/explodeMissile/checkMissileSpawn/context, PROJECTILE_ACTION_COUNT 4, wireProjectileActions; PROJECTILE_AIM_RANGE/NUDGE, MISSILE_SPAWN_Z_OFFSET, jitter masks, BFG_SPRAY_* constants) and src/world/radiusAttack.ts (radiusAttack splash). VANILLA_PROJECTILE_WEAPON_INVARIANTS pins five rules (4 registered actions; autoaim range+nudge; fixed spawn-z + tic jitter; 40-ray BFG spray over ANG90/2; explodeMissile -> radiusAttack splash). The focused test exercises the projectile constants, the four callable fire actions + explodeMissile/radiusAttack, the frozen manifest, the ../-filtered specifier set, and dynamic same-reference identity, keeping the test inventory-neutral. No const enums re-exported (verbatimModuleSyntax).
